text:
nina: FYI after the runtime rollforward this morning a subset of EU-hosted pools show subtle generation divergences (mostly short-context prompts). Thinking we should apply a staggered SDK pin for eu-hosted to avoid a full rollback. Need ops + QA signoff. :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: auto-scan: affected targets: eu-hosted-prod (models: llama3q-family), anomaly: generation-divergence detected in 8/100 sampled requests, suggested action: staggered sdk-pin scoped by pool-tag (pool=eu-warm) -> sdk@2.9.0.

ops-lead: can you clarify "staggered"? do you mean pin only warm pools first, monitor, then roll forward?

nina: exactly. plan: 1) pin eu-warm to sdk@2.9.0 now, 2) run 30m smoke, 3) if green, pin eu-cold next hour, 4) unpin after patch landed or after 12h. This keeps latency-sensitive traffic on current runtime while isolating divergence.

ryan: from runtime team: the divergence looks like a tokenizer detokenize edge with the new fused-attn path. SDK 2.9.1 includes a fix but we need to validate. Agree with staging the pin.

qa-bot: recent smoke (eu-warm test sample):
- gen_consistency: FAIL (8 diffs)
- api_surface: PASS
- latencies: PASS
link: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/900123

sec-bot: compliance check: short-lived region-scoped SDK pin is acceptable. Log change and notify security email list.

emma: +1 from SRE ops. Recommend change window 45m and a rollback threshold: gen-diff rate > 0.5% -> immediate rollback.

nina: commands we'll run: apply pin -> `/deploy pinlist add eu-hosted pool:eu-warm sdk-pin:sdk@2.9.0 --reason "staged mitigation for gen-divergence"` smoke -> `/ci run eu-warm-smoke --tag pinned` rollback -> `/deploy rollback eu-hosted --to sdk@2.9.0 --scope pool:eu-warm`. Runbook: /runbooks/eu-sdk-staggered-pin.md

deploy-bot: queued action: apply pinlist -> target=eu-hosted, scope=pool:eu-warm, entry=sdk-pin:sdk@2.9.0, requested_by=nina

deploy-bot: [completed] pin applied id=pin-20240410-07 at 1745123520

qa-bot: post-pin smoke (10m): gen_consistency: PASS (sampled 500 requests), latencies: PASS, api_surface: PASS. details: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/900125

ryan: great. I'll push SDK 2.9.1 candidate to CI for validation while we hold the pin. If 2.9.1 is green we can unpin and then roll the rest.

emma: ops note: documenting change window in change-log (change-id=chg-20240410-eu-staggered-pin). Will notify customers in eu-hosted status page if we extend beyond 3h.

nina: leaving checklist here: [x] pin eu-warm applied [x] smoke green [ ] pin eu-cold scheduled [ ] backport/2.9.1 validated

deploy-bot: closing thread: monitor for 12h or until unpin. If rollback triggered will create incident and notify #incidents.
